description: The agent release skill says committed UAT evidence no older than 21 days is required and stale evidence fails validate-base, but the current release guide and scripts/release_readiness_check.py make the three-stage UAT campaign advisory. The demotion landed in PR #1927. Correct the canonical benchbox release action in skill-sync-skills, then update BenchBox's immutable catalog rev in skill-sync.conf and regenerate the tracked .claude/skills mirror and ignored .agents/skills mirror through make skill-sync. Prior art: skill-sync.conf:7-17,33 declares the catalog source/pin; AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing generated mirrors. Decision: retain the local-develop-equals-origin/develop prose as a useful operator check or replace it with a reference to the new mechanical release-cut guard once that guard lands. Keep UAT advisory under current policy; any decision to make it blocking again requires an explicit later policy change and trusted-base rollout. Do not edit mirrors directly, treat tracker done as proof of current gate behavior, or make a release wait for optional UAT.
